name: DHL Supply Chain - East Coast Center of Excellence - Annville PA
type: Life Sciences & Healthcare Distribution Center (Foreign Trade Zone)

fieldNotes._general: Brand-new facility — DHL East Coast Center of Excellence, 700 Killinger Rd, Clear Springs Logistics Park, Annville PA. 1,000,000 sq ft, opened/opening 2026. Available satellite imagery was captured DURING construction: the building shell is complete but the surrounding truck yard and trailer-stall lot were still graded dirt (unpaved), and no Street View coverage exists. Gate/guard/yard finishing cannot be confirmed from imagery.
fieldNotes.truckGate: INFERRED. Not visible in construction-stage imagery. A new FDA/GMP-compliant pharma DC operating as a Foreign Trade Zone is, by industry norm, fully fenced and gated for customs/security control. Marked true on that basis but flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: INFERRED false / remoteGs INFERRED true. No booth visible; modern DCs of this type typically use kiosk/app check-in. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Per DHL press release: 100 dock doors. Building is a cross-dock with door banks on both the north and south long faces (visible in z18 imagery). Band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Press release cites 230 trailer parking stalls; in the available imagery the trailer lot was unpaved and empty (0 trailers visible). dropYard true (planned dedicated trailer lot), dropArea band NONE reflects 0 trailers actually visible in imagery.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building, dock banks on two opposite long faces.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Clear Springs Logistics Park is approved for three warehouses (~3M sq ft total); a second large building is under construction immediately NW.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Large undeveloped/paved-to-be yard gives ample room for express lanes.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: South Annville, Lebanon County PA — small-town / farmland edge setting = Rural.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~70 acres estimated for the 1M sq ft building parcel within the park.
